contact_edits.before: The acting is excellent, if occasionally forced, the actors being young but not that young. If there's a standout, it's Ben Lewis, who as Andrew has the most nuanced role, but Eli Ham (Cory) and Ashton Doudelet (Tiga) are equally involved and involving, while Sabryn Rock's Megan has the rhythms and attitudes of 21stcentury youth down to perfection. I saw the play with a house of seventh and eighth graders, and they never talked, coughed or snickered. - Dead Ahead runs until May 16. Call 416-862-2222 for more information.
